title: Learning Unsteady Aneurysm Hemodynamics with Physics-Informed DeepONets
abstract: arXiv:2608.13629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinically actionable, patient-specific hemodynamic assessment, specifically wall shear stress, vortex structure and pressure distributions, is critical for determining risky or unfavorable evolution in Abdominal Aortic Aneurysms (AAA). While Physics-Informed Deep Operator Networks (PI-DeepONets) show promising results in complementing established 5 tools such as Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), a persistent architectural challenge remains for complex 3D flows. In this direction, we propose a Modified Multi-Input Multi-Output PI-DeepONets (M3PI-DeepONet) designed for predicting unsteady flows in an idealized AAA geometry. translated_title: 基于物理信息深度算子网络的学习非定常动脉瘤血流动力学
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13629v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：临床可操作、患者特异性的血流动力学评估，特别是壁面剪切应力、涡旋结构和压力分布，对于判断腹主动脉瘤（AAA）的危险或不利演变至关重要。虽然物理信息深度算子网络（PI-DeepONets）在补充计算流体动力学（CFD）等成熟工具方面显示出 promising 结果，但复杂三维流动的架构挑战仍然存在。为此，我们提出了一种改进的多输入多输出物理信息深度算子网络（M3PI-DeepONet），用于预测理想化AAA几何中的非定常流动。我们模型的核心是聚合注入策略，其中多个输入分支的潜在表示在主干网络注入前融合，使坐标基能够适应多个物理约束。据我们所知，这是第一个结合逐层门控的架构。
tldr: 提出一种M3PI-DeepONet架构，通过聚合注入策略融合多输入分支，首次结合逐层门控，用于高效预测腹主动脉瘤中的非定常血流动力学，如壁面剪切应力和压力分布。
en_tdlr: The M3PI-DeepONet architecture, featuring an aggregated injection strategy and layer-wise gating, is the first of its kind to efficiently predict unsteady hemodynamics, such as wall shear stress and pressure, in idealized abdominal aortic aneurysms.
